question: Let \(O\) denote the origin and \(A,B\) denote respectively the points \((-10,0)\) and \((7,0)\) on the \(x\)-axis. For how many points \(P\) on the \(y\)-axis will the lengths of all the line segments \(PA,PO\) and \(PB\) be positive integers?

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
